page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-8-highlssd is a storage-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8481C processor clocked at 2.7 GHz, accompanied by 64 GB of RAM, equating to an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. The processor integrates advanced feature sets including AVX-512, AMX (tile and int8), and hardware cryptography extensions (AES, VAES, SHA-NI). Memory subsystem tests demonstrate 544.21 GB/sec cached read throughput, alongside uncached large-block read and write bandwidth of 53.42 GB/sec and 33.03 GB/sec respectively.

A major characteristic of this instance is the bundled local storage provision of 3,221 GB NVMe SSD. In benchmark evaluations, the instance records a multi-core Geekbench score of 6,517.0, a single-core score of 1,694.0, and a multi-core stress-ng rating of 6,644.94. Key workload execution markers include 8.92 million operations per second on Redis SET operations, 12.63 GB/sec static web serving throughput, and 3,908.44 operations on PassMark database testing. For machine learning tasks relying strictly on CPU resources, prompt processing achieves 55.98 tokens per second on a medium 7B model, though text generation is limited to 7.36 tokens per second.

From an infrastructure and cost efficiency perspective, z3-highmem-8-highlssd targets applications requiring coupled high-capacity, low-latency NVMe disk space alongside substantial memory per core. The absence of a dedicated GPU reduces suitability for heavy matrix-multiplication or generative model hosting, but the combination of AMX support, high memory density, and local NVMe storage makes it appropriate for distributed NoSQL databases, transactional engines, caching layers, and high-throughput data ingestion pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-8-highlssd is a storage-optimized instance delivering 8 dedicated vCPUs (4 physical cores) via an Intel Xeon 8481C processor running at 2.7 GHz, paired with 64 GB of memory and a bundled 3,221 GB local NVMe SSD. Operating on an x86_64 architecture with AVX-512 and AMX instructions, it delivers balanced performance including 8.92 million Redis SET operations per second, a Geekbench multi-core score of 6,517.0, and static web serving throughput of 12.63 GB/sec. With zero GPUs and an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, the server provides significant resource density for memory-bound and storage-intensive operational tasks. It is well matched for transactional databases, in-memory caches, data processing pipelines, and local NVMe-intensive backend services.
